title: AUTOMATE ATTENTION
author: diid
facts: INT8 per-channel quantized, stored in onchain data contracts
RoPE, RMSNorm, SiLU, KV cache — all in EVM opcodes
one aphorism per NFT, rendered as onchain SVG
description: A complete transformer language model running in EVM opcodes: OnChainLMv2 executes RMSNorm, rotary position embeddings, grouped-query attention, and SiLU feed-forward layers in fixed-point assembly, with INT8 per-channel quantized weights stored across onchain data contracts. The Automate Attention ERC-721 (0x12fd3dB5Ae10615873a4eadbE4085d0698965139) calls it at tokenURI time: a renderer feeds a market-condition prompt through precomputed KV caches and the model generates each token's permanent aphorism, decoded and drawn into an SVG entirely inside a static call. The address here is the language model itself; logits() runs one full forward pass and returns the raw distribution over all 2048 vocabulary entries.

call.note: logits([1]) — runs a full transformer forward pass and returns int16 logits for all 2048 vocabulary tokens

preview.note: Highest-scoring next-token predictions. Mapping token IDs to text requires the project's offchain BPE vocabulary.
